name: Sugino Shuuta
source:
"[i]Why do YOU get to have all the fun!? Switch with me![/i]"

The protagonist's best friend... or rather, his partner in crime.
Obsessed with gathering intel on girls, he's always the first to know about things like transfer students and immediately shares the scoop with the protagonist.
His weirdo reputation doesn't exactly make him popular with the ladies, but deep down, he's actually a considerate and caring guy.

Class: Hinamori Academy, Class 2-1
Height: 171cm
Birthday: December 3rd
Likes: All women are precious
Dislikes: Stiff, serious atmospheres
